title: Joiin recognized as Platinum Partner in the Intuit App Partner Program, delivering enhanced experiences to QuickBooks customers
summary: Joiin, a financial reporting and consolidation platform, today announced its participation in the Intuit App Partner Program, delivering smarter reporting at scale.
body_text: Joiin, a financial reporting and consolidation platform, today announced its participation in the Intuit App Partner Program , delivering smarter reporting at scale. Joiin automates group consolidation and single-entity reporting, with multi-currency FX built in. Intercompany eliminations, dashboards, and report packs sit alongside AI-driven insights and forecasting, providing finance teams with instant intelligence throughout the reporting cycle. The Intuit App Partner Program is designed to help third-party partners grow faster, scale smarter, and deliver more value to the millions of small- and mid-market businesses and accountants on the Intuit platform. As a member of the Platinum tier, Joiin receives early access to new and modernized APIs to develop rich functionality for its QuickBooks integration, co-marketing opportunities to drive customer growth and engagement, and analytics to better understand usage of their app. “Joining Intuit’s new partner program marks an exciting step for us,” said Lucien Wynn, co-founder and CEO at Joiin. “The improved APIs make it easier for us to deliver even greater value to our shared customers while deepening our relationship with Intuit and its global financial technology platform.” “Joiin’s robust reporting and automated consolidation of financial data and operations is helping accounting teams access insights, move faster, and make decisions,” said Josh Hofmann, Vice President, Global Partner Ecosystems, Intuit. “Their Platinum partner designation reflects the depth of their integration and the real impact they’re delivering for QuickBooks customers.” The impact of Joiin’s QuickBooks integration is already being seen by accounting firms managing complex group structures. “Joiin’s automated consolidation and multi-currency reporting has transformed how we support complex client groups, dramatically reducing the time spent on intercompany checks and manual validation,” said Rob te Braake, founder of Insight Matters . “For clients preparing for IPOs and the reporting standards expected by public markets such as Nasdaq, the speed, accuracy, and confidence Joiin delivers is critical. What once took days now takes minutes, giving us a reporting process that’s both robust and reliable.” For more than two decades, the Intuit Developer program has been instrumental in powering millions of QuickBooks customer experiences through thousands of integrated applications. With access to the Intuit App Marketplace , businesses on the Intuit platform use apps to meet their unique industry-specific needs, streamline processes with deep data flows, and save time with integrated, done-for-you experiences that drive growth, all in one place. Intuit’s new App Partner Program reflects its continued investment in partner success, offering enhanced support, data access, and business-building resources based on partner needs and maturity. By aligning with this initiative, Joiin reinforces its commitment to help growing small- and mid-market businesses streamline workflows , manage finances more efficiently, and thrive in today’s digital economy. Learn more about the Intuit App Partner Program . Joiin delivers scalable financial reporting and consolidation with unlimited users, reports, and consolidations. A 14-day free trial is available.

title: From A Few Engineers to Real Impact: 10 Years of Brno
summary: When I look back at how we started in Brno, it is hard to believe how far we have come.
body_text: By: Michal Kohoutek, Sr. Director of Engineering, Research & Development When I look back at how we started in Brno, it is hard to believe how far we have come. Interestingly, the story of Brno began with an acquisition that never happened . In 2016, the former NDS business was exploring opportunities to expand its integrated operating room (iOR) capabilities and acquire field programmable gate array (FPGA) expertise to support customizable video processing pipelines for surgical displays and video management systems. During that process, the leadership team discovered a small company in Brno that appeared to be an ideal fit. While the acquisition did not materialize at the time, we uncovered something equally important: the exceptional engineering talent, strong university ecosystem, and innovation potential of the region . That experience left a lasting impression on both the NDS leadership team and our corporate team. Rather than walk away, they recognized an opportunity to build those capabilities organically and made the decision to establish an engineering presence in Brno. Rainer Scholl, Senior Vice President, R&D , was one of the leaders who saw that potential early. We filled several key engineering positions quickly, and the first office space followed soon after. I joined during this formative period after being recruited by Rainer and was inspired by the vision of building a world-class engineering team that could drive innovation and growth for both NDS and our broader organization. What started as a small team of engineers working to establish new capabilities would eventually grow into a strategic location supporting multiple business units and functions across our global organization . Today, as we celebrate ten years in Brno, I am proud of what we have built together and even more excited about what lies ahead. The Early Years The early years were filled with challenges. As Miroslav Dítě, Hardware Team Manager , recalls, we had strong engineering talent and limited clarity on which products to develop and which markets to target. At the same time, Milan Šalomon, Lead System Architect, remembers the transition from a small company environment into a global organization, requiring new processes and ways of working across regions. We also had to prove ourselves. As Jiří Kříž, Sr. Software Design Engineer , recalls, earning trust to take on increasingly complex and business-critical work required persistence and strong execution. Alongside that effort, employees like David Kumhal, Tester and Verification Technician , helped establish the testing and service capabilities that continue to support product quality and reliability today. Even the basics had to be built from the ground up. Petr Kolesnikov, Lead Software Engineer , remembers starting in a simple meeting room while the team developed the infrastructure and tools needed to support future growth. As Marek Vaňura, Product Engineering Manager , recalls, building the site required far more than engineering. Employees stepped in wherever help was needed, establishing processes, sourcing equipment, developing supplier relationships, and creating a workplace where people wanted to stay and grow. Earning Trust Through Results One of the defining milestones was the CD1 project. Both Miroslav and Milan identify it as a turning point. Delivering a complex solution for a major customer with a relatively small team demonstrated what Brno was capable of and helped build confidence with customers and leaders alike. As our capabilities expanded, so did our responsibility. We moved from contributing to individual projects to owning entire product areas and strategic initiatives. What began with FPGA and hardware expertise evolved into full product ownership for iOR (Integrated Operating Room) solutions and expanded support across Advanced Surgery – Insufflators and Pumps, Detection & Analysis, Beam Steering and Scanning Solutions, Light Engines, CO₂ Lasers, product cyber-security, DevOps, automated testing, and other shared engineering services. At the same time, Brno’s impact expanded beyond engineering. Corporate Shared Services established capabilities in accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, master data management, and business systems support, helping create scalable processes and shared expertise that support teams across Europe and North America . Together, these technical and business capabilities strengthened Brno’s role as a strategic contributor across our global organization. Creating Real-World Impact For me, one of the most rewarding aspects of the past ten years is seeing our work reach customers. Many of us came from environments where interesting projects never became real products. Here, we develop solutions that are used every day . That creates a strong sense of purpose and reinforces the importance of staying focused on the customer and the product. Today, Brno supports nearly 200 employees across engineering and business functions and serves as a key contributor across our global organization . Alongside R&D, Corporate Shared Services has evolved from a transactional support function into a center of expertise focused on process improvement, systems support, scalability, and talent development. The team now supports financial operations across multiple regions while helping prepare the organization for future growth through business systems modernization and SAP S/4HANA initiatives. Our teams support the full product lifecycle , from architecture and development through verification, product cyber-security, automation, deployment, and sustaining engineering. Combined with a strong can-do attitude and deep technical expertise , that breadth of capability allows us to solve complex challenges and deliver high-quality solutions. I am especially proud of the role our teams have played in developing advanced iOR products used by healthcare organizations around the world. Whether designing software, testing products, verifying performance, or supporting quality, employees understand that their work can ultimately help healthcare professionals deliver better patient care. Looking Ahead What makes me proudest is not only what we have built, but the people who built it . Many of the employees who helped establish Brno are still here today, continuing to innovate and mentor others , shaping the future of the site. Looking ahead, I see Brno continuing to grow not only as a product development center but also as a competence hub where we can share specialized expertise across teams and business units, creating even greater value for our customers. I also see continued opportunities for Corporate Shared Services to grow as a center of excellence , leveraging Brno’s strong university talent pipeline along with data expertise and our collaborative culture to help scale processes and create additional value for the business. The next ten years will depend on the same principles that brought us this far: staying close to our customers, delivering products that matter, and working together as one team. I am confident our greatest achievements are still ahead of us.

body_text: Duolingo works for some learners, but many people find it overly gamified, too slow, or simply not built for how they absorb a new language. For anyone searching for Spanish For Beginners, TK: Best Duolingo Alternative For Spanish, the good news is that several strong options exist, each designed around different learning styles, goals, and schedules. Among the alternatives worth considering, Parrot stands out for its focus on real, natural sentences and native-speaker audio rather than repetitive drills. It builds practical skills at a steady pace without relying on streaks or point systems to keep users engaged. Those ready to take a more effective approach can learn Spanish with a method built around how language acquisition actually works. Table of Contents Why Spanish Learners Look for Duolingo Alternatives What to Look for in a Duolingo Alternative for Spanish 7 Best Duolingo Alternatives for Spanish Which Duolingo Alternative Is Right for Your Learning Goal? How Parrot Helps Spanish Learners Move From Practice to Conversation Start Learning Spanish Today Summary Most Spanish learners who leave Duolingo do not quit because of low motivation. They leave because the app was designed for getting started, not for reaching fluency. Gamification builds consistent habits, but habits built around earning points do not automatically transfer to real comprehension or conversation. The gap between performing well in an app and understanding native speech at full speed is a methodological problem, not a personal failure. Listening comprehension is consistently underestimated as a skill, and most apps make this worse by using slow, studio-recorded audio that does not reflect how Spanish actually sounds in Oaxaca, Bogotá, or Madrid. Learners who train almost exclusively on clean, controlled audio often find themselves unable to understand anything when a real conversation starts. Exposure to authentic native-speaker speech, with regional accents, dropped syllables, and informal phrasing, needs to be built into the learning process early rather than treated as an advanced skill. Grammar instruction and immersive exposure are not interchangeable, and choosing the wrong approach for your learning style creates compounding friction over time. Some learners need to understand the logic behind a structure before they can use it confidently. Others absorb grammar naturally through repeated exposure to real input. Being honest about which type of learner you are before committing to a platform can save you months of stalled progress. Consistency in language learning is less about discipline and more about format fit. According to Babbel, lessons designed for as little as 15 minutes per day outperform longer weekend study sessions in terms of retention. The learners who build fluency are rarely the ones who study hardest in concentrated bursts. They are the ones who made the habit small enough that skipping felt stranger than continuing. Over 90% of language app users plateau before reaching conversational fluency, according to Parrot Blog. That statistic reflects a structural problem with most apps: they train recognition rather than production. Recognizing the correct answer in a multiple-choice exercise uses a completely different cognitive process than producing a sentence in real time while someone is waiting for a response. Adults learning a Category 1 language like Spanish can reach conversational proficiency in 18 to 24 months, according to Noun Town Blog, but learners who choose the right tool early and stay consistent reach that level significantly faster. Vocabulary gaps are frequently misdiagnosed as speaking problems. When a learner understands the grammar but runs out of words mid-sentence, the issue is not fluency mechanics but vocabulary depth. Words learned in real sentences, with situational and emotional context, are retained far more reliably than translation pairs studied in isolation. Contextual exposure encodes meaning alongside memory in a way that flashcard drilling does not replicate. Parrot's Learn Spanish addresses the recognition-versus-production gap by delivering comprehensible input through short-form native-speaker video, a format designed to build fluency through daily immersive exposure rather than drill completion. Why Spanish Learners Look for Duolingo Alternatives Learners don't quit Duolingo because they give up. They leave because they outgrew it . The app excels at getting you started, but that's not enough — and for serious learners, "enough" is never the goal. "The app is great at getting you started, but that stops being enough." — A reality millions of Spanish learners face every year. 💡 Tip: If Duolingo feels too easy or too repetitive , that's not a motivation problem. That's a signal you've hit the app's ceiling . Spanish is the second most spoken language in the world , with over 500 million native speakers , according to the Clozemaster Blog . That massive scale means the language exists across a huge range of real conversations , regional accents , and social contexts that no single app can fully capture. Duolingo introduces you to Spanish — it was never designed to make you fluent in it. 🔑 Takeaway: With 500 million+ native speakers spread across dozens of countries and dialects, Spanish fluency demands far more than gamified drills — it requires exposure to real-world language variety that Duolingo simply wasn't built to deliver. A learner completes hundreds of lessons, holds a 300-day streak, and feels productive. Then they try to follow a native speaker at normal speed, and the words blur together. The gap between performing well in an app and understanding real Spanish is not a motivation problem—it's a method problem. Gamification builds habits, but habits built around earning points don't transfer to comprehension or conversation. Most learners who hit this wall can recognize vocabulary in isolation but freeze when words arrive in clusters, wrapped in slang, spoken fast, and loaded with cultural context. This freeze reflects what happens when language learning relies on drills and rewards rather than meaningful exposure to real input. According to the 2025 Duolingo Language Report , Spanish is the most studied language on Duolingo. But popularity and effectiveness are not equivalent. Does switching apps actually change how you acquire Spanish? The instinct to search for an app with more conversation practice or better listening exercises makes sense. But the real question is: does the alternative change how you learn language, or does it rearrange the same drills in a different interface? Apps like Parrot take a structurally different approach, using short-form video content from native speakers to create immersion through comprehensible input rather than activity completion. Consistency stops depending on willpower and happens naturally. The reason you plateaued matters more than the plateau itself. Why does matching app training to your real goals matter? The problem occurs when what an app teaches doesn't match what you need to do. Most language apps are built around reading and recognition —they measure whether you can identify the right answer, not whether you can produce language under pressure. Learners who study this way for months can fill in blanks accurately but freeze when a native speaker responds at full speed with dropped syllables and regional expressions they've never heard. If your goal is conversation, prioritize platforms that require you to speak, respond, and listen to real Spanish, not tap the correct tile. How much weight should listening comprehension get in your practice? Listening comprehension deserves as much weight as speaking practice. App-based audio is typically slower and cleaner than authentic speech, lacking the informal contractions and regional rhythms that define Spanish in Oaxaca, Bogotá, or Madrid. Seek platforms that expose you to native-speaker speech rather than studio recordings read slowly for learners. Does your learning style match the method you're using? Grammar instruction is a dividing line. Some learners need to understand why "me gusta" works the way it does before they can use it confidently. Others learn grammar naturally through repeated exposure and prefer hearing a phrase in ten different contexts to reading a rule once. Neither approach is wrong, but choosing an app built for the opposite style creates friction that accumulates over time. What makes some learners more consistent than others? The most consistent learners are often not the most disciplined, but those who integrate learning into their everyday habits. Parrot delivers comprehensible input through short videos from native speakers, a format that aligns with how people already use their phones. Ask the right questions before you decide Cost matters less than fit. A platform that costs more but directly addresses your specific gap—pronunciation feedback, immersive listening, or structured grammar progression —delivers more value than a cheaper one you abandon. Ask: "Does this solve the problem keeping me from improving?" not "What's the price?" Once you know what you're looking for, the next step is the one most learners find surprisingly difficult. 7 Best Duolingo Alternatives for Spanish Seven platforms stand out as real alternatives to Duolingo for Spanish learners. Parrot The most common frustration among Spanish learners isn't vocabulary: it's understanding Spanish on paper but freezing in real conversation. Most apps train recognition, not production. Learn Spanish with Parrot closes that gap. How does Parrot build real conversational fluency? Parrot uses short-form video immersion based on Dr. Stephen Krashen's comprehensible input theory: fluency develops when you absorb real language slightly above your current ability, not through drills or grammar tables. The TikTok-style format transforms a scrolling habit into daily Spanish immersion, making consistency a design feature rather than a discipline problem. Why do most language app users plateau before fluency? According to Parrot Blog , over 90% of language app users stop making progress before they can talk naturally. The problem isn't effort; it's method. When the language you read isn't real, and you never practice speaking, you won't become fluent. Lessons are built around practical dialogues and real-world situations, with grammar instruction woven in naturally. Learners who struggled with high school Spanish often find Babbel's explanation-first style more satisfying than Duolingo's pattern-repetition approach. If you want to understand why the subjunctive exists before using it, Babbel delivers that. Best for Structured learners seeking grammar instruction with vocabulary and speaking practice. 3. After completing writing or speaking exercises, you submit them to the community for corrections from fluent speakers worldwide. This feedback loop is important. While automated apps check if answers are right or wrong, native speakers identify unnatural phrasing—the difference between textbook Spanish and real Spanish. Best for Learners who want structured lessons paired with genuine human feedback . 4. Rosetta Stone Rosetta Stone teaches Spanish almost entirely through images, audio, and context rather than English translation, forcing you to think directly in the language rather than mentally translating to English. This approach works well for learners frustrated by translation-heavy methods and builds strong listening instincts early by requiring you to interpret meaning from context . Best for Immersion-focused learners who want to build intuitive comprehension without relying on their first language. 5. Pimsleur Pimsleur is audio-first by design. This means commutes, gym sessions, and long drives become Spanish practice time without extra planning. For busy learners with free ears, Pimsleur fits into what you already do rather than consuming additional time. Best for Audio learners who want to build pronunciation and conversational ability during daily movement. 6. Memrise Memrise builds vocabulary through spaced recall and native-speaker video content. Short clips show real people using everyday Spanish in natural, unscripted ways, exposing learners to regional accents, informal phrasing, and the rhythm of actual speech. Many learners understand slow, clear audio but struggle with real-world speech. Memrise narrows that gap earlier than most vocabulary tools. Best for Learners who want to expand vocabulary while training their ear for authentic Spanish. 7. FluentU FluentU uses real Spanish media—news clips, interviews, music videos, and short films—as primary learning material. Interactive subtitles let learners click on any word for instant definitions and examples, tracking vocabulary across multiple videos. This exposes learners to Spanish as it exists in culture, not in textbooks. Intermediate learners with solid foundations often find FluentU speeds up comprehension faster than structured courses. Best for Intermediate learners ready to engage with authentic Spanish content and cultural context. Which tool belongs in your Spanish learning stack right now? No single app covers every skill equally well. Serious learners typically combine two or three tools: one for speaking, one for vocabulary, one for immersive listening, because different platforms solve different problems at different stages. The harder question is which tool belongs in your stack now, and the answer depends on where your Spanish is breaking down. title: How to Get Leads for Your Business: Expert-Tested Strategies That Actually Work
summary: Discover expert-tested strategies to get more leads for your business. Learn proven methods to attract quality prospects and grow your revenue fast.
body_text: A striking 6 in 10 marketers make generating business leads their top priority. This makes sense since 22% of CEOs and CMOs rank lead generation as their primary focus for the next 12 months – with only customer retention ranking higher. Timing plays a crucial role in getting leads for your business. Your chances of converting leads jump by 391% if you reach out within the first 60 minutes. But many businesses face challenges with targeted lead generation . While 71% of customers expect tailored experiences, just 36% of buyers put their trust in company employees. The flip side shows that 59% trust what their peers at other businesses recommend. Our team tested many lead generation strategies for B2B companies and found that SEO delivers one of the highest ROIs thanks to its low customer acquisition cost. Lead generation success goes beyond this single approach. Data shows that companies with 10-15 landing pages bring in 55% more leads compared to those using fewer than 10 pages. In this piece, we'll walk you through proven tactics that help generate B2B leads that convert . You'll learn both free online methods and adaptable systems that grow alongside your business. Build a Strong Foundation for Targeted Lead Generation Your success in lead generation depends on how well you know your ideal customers. Companies that use buyer personas see 73% higher conversions compared to those who don't. This makes customer understanding crucial to your business growth. A detailed Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) should outline the perfect company fit for your product or service. Your ICP needs to combine demographic, firmographic, and environmental characteristics. This combination helps you target prospects who are more likely to convert. Buyer personas represent specific individuals within your target companies. These semi-fictional profiles combine audience data into relatable characters. Your team can better understand customers' pain points and motivations. Most companies start with two to five buyer personas and refine them as their offerings grow. Accurate targeting requires both firmographic data (company size, industry, revenue, location) and technographic information (technology stack and software usage). This data creates a complete view of your prospects. You can then shift from broad segmentation to hyper-specific targeting . Time invested in this foundation brings strong returns. A deep understanding of existing customers ' needs helps you address prospects' questions effectively. You can solve their challenges and meet their expectations, which guides more qualified leads to your business. Inbound Strategies to Attract High-Intent Leads Content marketing brings in three times more leads than traditional marketing methods. This makes inbound strategies crucial to attract high-intent prospects. SEO has emerged as one of the best ROI-driven lead generation strategies because it keeps customer acquisition costs low . When your bottom-of-funnel content ranks organically, you'll see amazing results. Creating comparison pages that show how you stack up against competitors can bring in qualified leads quickly . Your search visibility also improves when you publish long-form content that showcases your expertise. Your landing pages need the right optimization strategy . Pages with multiple offers can make your conversion rates drop by 266% . The best approach is to stick to one offer per page and use clear, compelling calls-to-action. Gated content helps you generate leads effectively: Ebooks and white papers : Over 80% of B2B content marketing assets need a form fill Webinars : Success rate of 70% in generating conversions Interactive quizzes : Get 52.6% more engagement than static content Templates : Users find immediate value in these practical resources Lead magnets help 50% of marketers boost their conversion rates. You can encourage prospects to share their contact details by giving them valuable resources like checklists, free tools, or exclusive industry insights. Progressive profiling techniques work best here. They help you collect information gradually through multiple interactions. This lets you customize engagement without creating friction when someone first converts. Outbound and Automation Tactics That Scale Outbound automation tactics create expandable systems for lead acquisition alongside inbound marketing. AI chatbots have become powerful lead generation tools that operate 24/7 and streamline processes through automated lead qualification and data collection. These conversational AI solutions boost conversion rates by a lot - companies report their chatbot leads exceed 40% compared to traditional landing pages at 2.35%. Customer testimonials work as exceptional lead generation assets because 85% of people trust online reviews as much as recommendations from friends and family. Video testimonials prove especially effective when 77% of viewers say they influenced their purchasing decisions. Retargeting previous website visitors produces impressive results. Retargeting ads average 0.7% CTR compared to general display campaigns' 0.07% . B2B companies benefit from lower costs per high-intent visitor and better quality leads. Webinars remain a top lead generation source, with 73% of B2B marketers ranking them highest. These interactive sessions generate an average cost-per-lead of $72, which is nowhere near the cost of SEM ($92) or trade shows ($800+). Your CRM system should combine smoothly with these tactics. This comprehensive approach creates a continuous connection where AI-identified leads flow directly to your sales team to follow up quickly. Your lead generation efforts will expand without increasing your workload proportionally. Conclusion Quality lead generation is the life-blood of business growth, as our strategy exploration shows. Companies build a strong foundation through detailed ICPs and buyer personas that achieve substantially better results than those skipping this significant step. Content marketing proves its worth by generating three times more leads than traditional approaches. SEO continues to deliver exceptional ROI through targeted organic visibility. Successful lead generation campaigns demonstrate the strength of using multiple approaches together. Companies that blend inbound and outbound methods create complete systems working in harmony. Bottom-of-funnel content attracts high-intent leads while AI chatbots qualify them 24/7 . Well-designed landing pages combined with strategic retargeting campaigns create a powerful mix that captures interested prospects at different stages of their trip. Your business must personalize its approach while staying efficient. Recent conversion rates soar when teams respond to leads within the first minute, making automated systems not just convenient but essential. Your CRM integration creates the smooth workflow needed for timely follow-ups and consistent lead nurturing. The digital world will without doubt keep evolving, though the core principles stay constant know your audience, deliver value, and build scalable systems. You can find more lead generation strategies and business growth tips in our blog at Persana.ai/blogs . Note that successful lead generation needs both creativity and consistency. Test these proven methods, analyze your results, and adapt your approach based on what works best for your specific business needs. Key Takeaways These expert-tested lead generation strategies will help you build a systematic approach to attracting and converting high-quality prospects for sustainable business growth. • Build detailed buyer personas and ICPs first - Marketers using buyer personas see 73% higher conversions than those who skip this foundation step. • Focus on content marketing for 3x better results - Content marketing generates three times more leads than traditional methods, with SEO offering the highest ROI. • Respond to leads within 60 seconds - Quick response times increase conversion chances by 391%, making automation tools essential for scaling. • Use multiple landing pages strategically - Businesses with 10-15 landing pages generate 55% more leads than those with fewer than 10 pages. • Combine inbound and outbound tactics - AI chatbots, retargeting ads, and webinars create scalable systems that work 24/7 to qualify and nurture prospects.

title: Is Your Meal Delivery Cooked in Seed Oils? How to Check in 2 Minutes
summary: Audit your meal delivery service for hidden seed oils in just two minutes. Learn the exact words to look for and how to ensure your food is truly clean.
body_text: The Hidden Oils Lurking in Prepared Meals Most prepared meal services quietly cut corners by relying on cheap, highly processed seed oils like soybean and canola oil. These industrial fats make up roughly half of the domestic food oil supply because they lower mass-production costs and artificially extend shelf life. However, this processing convenience comes at a steep physiological cost. While human beings evolved on an omega-6 to omega-3 essential fatty acid ratio of approximately 1:1, the modern Western diet has pushed this balance to an inflammatory ratio of 15:1 to 16.7:1 [1] . Pre-cooked proteins: Meats are frequently seared or baked in bulk soybean oil to prevent sticking on high-volume assembly lines. Dressings and sauces: Mayonnaise, vinaigrettes, and rich pestos almost universally use canola or safflower oil as their emulsification base. Marinades and glazes: Used to coat chicken or beef to retain moisture during transit, masking hidden industrial fats in otherwise healthy meals. These industrial seed oils are packed with linoleic acid, a highly unstable polyunsaturated fatty acid. When subjected to the high heat of commercial processing, linoleic acid oxidizes rapidly, generating harmful lipid peroxides and trans fats. Because these fats are heavily integrated into pre-made ingredients, unsuspecting health optimizers absorb a constant stream of oxidized lipids that can trigger cellular dysfunction and systemic inflammation. Our commitment to avoiding these inflammatory oils is a non-negotiable standard, which is why we also exclude them alongside dozens of other additives on our transparent list of banned ingredients . The 2-Minute Audit: Red-Flag Words and Label Realities Many prepared meal services claim to offer clean nutrition, but their ingredient lists often tell a different story. To maintain profit margins, mass-market brands routinely sneak industrial seed oils into pre-cooked proteins, marinades, and dressings. For active health optimizers tracking their omega-6 to omega-3 ratio, these hidden fats can quietly drive metabolic inflammation and undermine physical performance. Vetting a service takes less than two minutes when you know exactly where and how to look. Check the dressing first: Creamy sauces, vinaigrettes, and marinades are the primary hiding spots for cheap oils. Audit the protein: Look closely at pre-cooked chicken, beef, or tofu, which are frequently pre-seared or coated in seed-derived fats. Spot the aliases: Watch out for canola, soybean, sunflower, safflower, corn, cottonseed, and generic vegetable oil listed under any name. Many brands hide these fats behind vague, generic terminology like vegetable oil blend or natural flavors. Under federal labeling rules, these broad categories can mask highly refined, chemically deodorized solvents like hexane-extracted soybean or canola oil. A fast visual review of the ingredient deck should reveal zero mention of these industrial fats. If a meal service does not publish a complete, transparent ingredient list for every single sauce and protein component online before you order, it is safe to assume they are cutting corners with cheap cooking fats. At Locale, we built the whole menu on absolute transparency. We don't hide behind generic labels or blend cheap oils into our meals. We cook strictly with olive and avocado oil, and our rigorous standards exclude industrial fats entirely from our rotating menu, backed by a strict list of 60+ banned ingredients to ensure your performance fuel is completely clean. Sourcing Secrets: Key Questions to Ask Support Before Subscribing Many prepared meal services claim to offer healthy eating, yet they hide industrial seed oils in pre-cooked proteins, marinades, and pre-made dressings to cut costs. In mass production, meat is often pre-seared by suppliers using cheap soybean or canola oil before it ever reaches the meal service kitchen. Salad dressings and sauces are another frequent hiding place, where highly refined oils serve as cheap emulsifiers and stabilizers [2] . If a meal kit company does not publish a complete, line-by-line ingredient list for every single sauce and protein online, you must look past their marketing copy and ask direct questions. Active health optimizers know that even small amounts of oxidized linoleic acid can disrupt the omega-6 to omega-3 ratio, making verification essential. Do your suppliers use soybean, canola, or sunflower oil to pre-cook, sear, or marinate the chicken, beef, or tofu before delivery? Are your salad dressings, marinades, and aiolis made in-house, or are they sourced from third parties that use vegetable oil blends? Do you have a strict policy against using seed oils in any cooking processes, and can you provide the complete ingredient list for your spice rubs and sauces? When you message support, watch out for evasive replies. Red flags include answers like we use a healthy vegetable oil blend, our ingredients vary weekly, or our cooking oils are proprietary. If they cannot guarantee that every component is seed-oil-free, they are likely cutting corners. This lack of clarity is exactly why we built a zero-compromise alternative. At Locale, we maintain absolute transparency by cooking strictly with organic olive oil and avocado oil, helping you avoid the metabolic disruptions associated with seed oils. Locale serves the SF Bay Area and Los Angeles with meals designed for longevity, providing 40-60g of quality protein with zero seed oils, verified by independent testing. Radical Transparency: Why Locale Publishes Every Single Ingredient At Locale, we built the menu on a simple premise: you should never have to guess what is in your food. While mass-market meal services quietly cut corners with industrial fats, we maintain a strict seed oil policy, cooking only with 100% olive oil and avocado oil. We exclude everything on our list of 60+ Banned Ingredients so that you can hit your metabolic goals without the systemic inflammation caused by chemically processed lipids. Our commitment to safety goes beyond the recipe. We independently test every batch of food through Light Labs for heavy metals, pesticides, phthalates, PFAS, and other toxins — and we publish the results rather than just claiming them. Researchers estimate the average person already consumes tens of thousands of microplastic particles a year from food and drink [3] , which is one reason we deliver in reusable glass jars rather than plastic containers. Partner-Brand Sourcing: We source from trusted local partners including Lakeside Organic Gardens, Diestel Family Ranch, Monterey Fish Market, and Rancho Gordo. Nutrient-Dense Inclusions: We pack 40-60g of protein into every meal using functional ingredients like bone broth-infused rice, edamame noodles, and Greek yogurt-based sauces . Verified by Experts: Our rigorous approach has earned the trust of health leaders like author Max Lugavere, a16z General Partner Connie Chan, Superhuman CEO Rahul, and Alex Mather . Frequently asked questions How do meal delivery services hide seed oils in their food? Meal delivery services often hide seed oils in components that are not fully detailed on standard online menus. While a dish might list a clean protein like chicken breast, the marinade, sauce, or salad dressing used in that dish is frequently cooked or prepped with cheap industrial seed oils like soybean or canola. Soybean oil alone accounts for roughly half of domestic edible oil consumption in the U.S. because it is incredibly cheap and acts as a high-heat preservative, making it the default choice for mass-market kitchens. What specific ingredients should I look for on a meal prep label to spot seed oils? When reviewing ingredients, look out for the "Big Eight" industrial oils: soybean, canola (often listed as rapeseed), corn, cottonseed, sunflower, safflower, grapeseed, and rice bran oil. Be cautious of vague terms like "vegetable oil," "cooking spray," or "natural flavors," which frequently mask seed oil blends. Truly transparent meal subscriptions will explicitly name the fats they use for every component, ensuring they do not hide these highly processed ingredients in their dressings or marinades. Why are industrial seed oils considered unhealthy for active health optimizers? Industrial seed oils are high in omega-6 fatty acids, specifically linoleic acid. A landmark study by Dr. Artemis Simopoulos shows that the typical Western diet has an omega-6 to omega-3 ratio of 15:1 to 16.7:1, compared to an evolutionary ratio of 1:1. This severe imbalance can drive systemic inflammation and metabolic dysfunction. Furthermore, these oils are chemically extracted using solvents like hexane, then bleached and deodorized under extreme heat, which oxidizes the fragile polyunsaturated fats before they even reach your plate. What questions should I ask support to verify if a meal service is seed-oil-free? If a meal service is vague about their ingredients, ask support these three questions: First, "Do you use canola, soybean, or vegetable oil in any pre-cooked proteins or marinades?" Second, "Are your salad dressings made with 100% olive oil or avocado oil, or is there a seed oil blend?" Third, "Do your sub-contracted kitchens or supplier farms use cooking sprays containing soy lecithin or seed oils during food preparation?" If support cannot give a straight answer, it is safe to assume they use seed oils. Does Locale use any seed oils or processed ingredients in its meals? No. Locale's meals are entirely free of seed oils, refined sugars, and over 60 banned ingredients, cooked strictly with olive oil and avocado oil only. Locale also independently third-party lab tests every batch through Light Labs for heavy metals, pesticides, phthalates, PFAS, and other toxins, and publishes the results online. Because researchers estimate the average person consumes tens of thousands of microplastic particles a year from food and drink, Locale packages all meals in reusable glass jars. title: Faster Elasticsearch issue triage with redesigned AutoOps
summary: See how redesigned AutoOps improves Elasticsearch cluster monitoring with clearer severity, faster event triage, and simpler configuration.
body_text: Simplify your Elasticsearch operations with real-time issue detection and actionable recommendations to optimize performance and reduce costs. AutoOps is available for cloud and self-managed deployments. Learn more about AutoOps . AutoOps has a redesigned experience for Elastic Cloud Hosted deployments and Cloud Connect clusters. The update adds a new Critical severity level and refreshes every page, including Template Optimizer, Nodes, Shards and Overview. Updated layouts and navigation make Elasticsearch issues easier to scan and triage. This post covers the redesigned UI and where AutoOps is headed next, including a headless, agentic experience. The redesigned AutoOps deployment view with a clearer event timeline and separation between open and closed events Why AutoOps for Elasticsearch needs clearer prioritization Running Elasticsearch at scale requires administrators to monitor cluster health, performance, capacity, and configuration at the same time. AutoOps now provides a clearer way to distinguish conditions that threaten cluster functionality from significant but less urgent degradation. The redesigned interface also follows familiar Elastic Cloud Console patterns, making active issues easier to find and investigate. What changed in AutoOps: severity, navigation, configuration, and page design The monitoring engine remains the same. The redesigned layout, navigation, and workflows now follow familiar Elastic patterns. A clearer severity model New event severity and re-classified events severity. We added Critical as a new severity level for conditions that pose an immediate threat to cluster functionality and require urgent intervention. Several events previously classified as High are now Critical. Others are now Medium because they represent potential risk rather than active, significant degradation. The reclassified events are: Promoted from High to Critical: Disk Watermark Flood Stage, Master Not Discovered, and Status Red. Demoted from High to Medium: Disk Watermark Low Threshold, Disk Watermark Low, and Disk Watermark Configuration Incorrect. Severity What it means Critical Immediate threat to cluster functionality. Urgent intervention required. High Significant degradation to usability, performance, or stability. Medium Potential risk that can escalate if left unaddressed. Low Minor anomalies with minimal operational impact. Info Routine operational updates and configuration changes. No action required. (Coming in a near-future update). Every severity level ships with an updated icon set and color palette. Levels are fixed so teams can build consistent runbooks and notification filters: route Critical and High events to PagerDuty or Slack, keep Medium and Low in the console for periodic review, and when Info arrives, use it for awareness without alert fatigue. Deployment view: open events and history, side by side The redesigned deployment view presents the existing Open events and Event history tabs in a clearer layout. "Separate tabs for open events and history keep current issues and past activity easy to scan." Event flyout: a clearer view of what matters The event detail flyout is redesigned around action. High-severity events include a notification callout and an interactive badge that shows whether alerts are configured and links directly to setup. Recommendations collapse by default so the core event stays in focus. Settings live in the flyout menu; share is a separate icon in the header. The Dismiss action appears only when your role has the required admin permissions and the event is dismissible. "The event flyout surfaces notification setup and recommended actions without leaving the insight." AutoOps overview: triage active events across your Elasticsearch fleet The Overview page is reorganized around how operators scan an estate. Elasticsearch context sits directly under the page header, and active events appear as event ribbons below the deployments table. Each ribbon shows the latest active event in your selected time range; if the same event type is open on other deployments, a new badge lets you expand the view without opening each resource individually. Event search moved to the left for quicker filtering. The “Events over time” chart moved off Overview to keep this page focused on fleet-level triage; open a single deployment when you need that timeline. "Event ribbons group active issues across deployments so you can triage without opening each one." Nodes, Shards, and Indices are designed with easier navigation and information hierarchy Nodes view now uses updated chart components and the Elastic UI color scheme, with clear expansion indicators on accordion sections. Event and instance lists that duplicated deployment-level views were removed to reduce noise. Shards view improves node selection and groups view controls in the upper-right corner. A horizontal scrollbar supports wider layouts, and the time slider now uses native Elastic UI components. Node selection in Shards view now works across larger clusters and presents up to 100 nodes at a time. "Shards view consolidates controls and uses native Elastic UI components for time-range selection." Index view keeps the Indices table experience you already use, including sorting, time-range brushing, and chart zoom behavior tuned for meaningful ranges. Template Optimizer The Template Optimizer now provides a searchable list of templates ordered by the most recently identified recommendations. You can open each recommendation directly or expand the JSON panel to inspect the complete template. "Template optimizer shows list of templates based on last found issues and improved search abilities." Configure notifications and event settings Notification settings now include connector search, clearer filters, and a simpler connector editing flow. Event settings moved from a popup to a flyout, matching the pattern used across AutoOps. Notification reports retain the same 10-day history window with minor layout updates, and dismiss events use updated confirmation components aligned with Elastic UI. "Event settings with easier navigation and applying customization across multiple clusters” Navigation and controls The deployment picker now shows deployment ID and real-time cluster status, with copy actions for deployment name and ID in the dropdown sub-menu. Node selection supports select-all, select-by-tier grouping, and clear master node indication. The date picker follows the same relative-range and custom-range model used in Kibana and other Cloud Console monitoring views. AutoOps roadmap: API, MCP, CLI, and agentic experience Looking ahead, we are building toward a headless, agentic AutoOps experience. A forthcoming public AutoOps API will make insights and raw metrics available outside the AutoOps interface. Administrators and agents will be able to query the API directly or store its data in Elasticsearch. The API will also provide the foundation for integrations with MCP , Elastic Agent Builder , the Elastic CLI, Kibana, and native AutoOps chat. Hosted MCP server: Make AutoOps insights available to MCP clients such as Claude and Cursor. Native Elastic Agent Builder tool : Use AutoOps insights in Elastic Agent Builder. Elastic CLI support: Access the AutoOps API through the Elastic CLI. AutoOps in Kibana: Surface relevant insights and metrics within Kibana. Native AutoOps chat : Investigate cluster issues through an agentic chat experience within AutoOps UI in Elastic Cloud Console. The application redesign is the foundation; these surfaces will meet operators where automation and AI already live. Read more about what is coming on the Elastic public roadmap . How to start using the redesigned AutoOps in Elastic Cloud Console Sign in to Elastic Cloud Console , open a deployment, project, or connected cluster, and select AutoOps from the navigation. Learn more in the AutoOps documentation . The release and timing of any features or functionality described in this post remain at Elastic's sole discretion.
